Entry 9: Fugitives Part 1: Maria
Full name: Afrodisia Marina Megalou
Known as: Maria, Mariyya, Mariya, Mariyyah, Marya, Maryah, Mariah (not pronounced like the famous singer)
Height: 9' 6" (289.56 centimeters) 
Weight: 459 pounds (208.2 kilograms)
Birthplace: Néa Athína, Greece, Mars
Residence Prior to Wartime: Unknown, but at some point she lived in Eskenderiyya Gideed, Egypt, Mars
Residence Now: Unknown
Parents (Alive or Dead): Menelaos Megalos and Eleni Megalou
Marital Status: Single
Spouse(s): N/A
Parents-in-Law (Alive or Dead): N/A
Number of Children (Alive or Dead): 0
Crime(s): Assault, Sexual Assault, Prostitution, Slander, Draft Evasion, Battery, Criminal Coercion, Robbery, Theft, Burglary, and Fraud
Bounty Award: 10,000 pounds of  beans
Threat Level: 10/10
Reasons for Assigned Threat Level: She is strong, being able to lift twice her weight, and is also pretty fast. 
She usually has a weapon on her too.
 She is very aggressive, has a bad temper, and is a master manipulator and seductor. 
She is incredibly dangerous, a menace to society, an enemy of God, and will do anything to achieve her goals.
Instructions for Citizens: Don't ever go near her and don't ever interact with her. Don't listen to what she says. 
When you see her, call the authorities. Don't fight her and don't use any weapon against her. 
Bullets will for sure work on her, but God, the government, and the authorites don't want her dead.
